serverMetadata.instructions:
The GitHub MCP Server provides tools to interact with GitHub platform.

Tool selection guidance:
	1. Use 'list_*' tools for broad, simple retrieval and pagination of all items of a type (e.g., all issues, all PRs, all branches) with basic filtering.
	2. Use 'search_*' tools for targeted queries with specific criteria, keywords, or complex filters (e.g., issues with certain text, PRs by author, code containing functions).

Context management:
	1. Use pagination whenever possible with batches of 5-10 items.
	2. Use minimal_output parameter set to true if the full information is not needed to accomplish a task.

Tool usage guidance:
	1. For 'search_*' tools: Use separate 'sort' and 'order' parameters if available for sorting results - do not include 'sort:' syntax in query strings. Query strings should contain only search criteria (e.g., 'org:google language:python'), not sorting instructions.

# Mobile homes with Structural Brick and CMU Wall Types #1309

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/NatLabRockies/resstock/issues/1309)

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/NatLabRockies/resstock/issues/1309)

Open

Open

[Mobile homes with Structural Brick and CMU Wall Types](/NatLabRockies/resstock/issues/1309#top)#1309

## Description

[![@afontani](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/37630588?u=c4934524fdc120b455a1d0d2c2bcbec766e05df2&v=4&size=48)](https://github.com/afontani)

[afontani](https://github.com/afontani)

opened [on Oct 4, 2024](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/resstock/issues/1309#issue-2567241445)

There are places in the US where a lot of the mobile homes have Structural Brick and CMU Wall Types. This was originally identified by [@nmerket](https://github.com/nmerket). The Geometry Wall Type characteristic is where this wall type is assigned. The distribution is based on the Lighbox data. It is possible that these assessor data is not the greatest and there could be confusion with the foundation or the skirting of the manufactured homes.

See the screenshot below.

[![Screenshot 2024-10-04 at 2 00 10 PM](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/37630588/373793451-f34d907b-b5bb-4e93-9590-32d8e743116c.png?jwt=******

Reacted by Noel Merket

    [![@nmerket](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/5325034?v=4&size=48)](/nmerket)

    [nmerket](/nmerket)

    [on Oct 4, 2024](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/resstock/issues/1309#issuecomment-2394685410)

    Thanks for looking into this [@afontani](https://github.com/afontani).

2.  ### afontani commented on Oct 16, 2024

    [![@afontani](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/37630588?u=c4934524fdc120b455a1d0d2c2bcbec766e05df2&v=4&size=48)](/afontani)

    ContributorAuthor

    Also, a broader look is warranted for the lightbox data. It also shows that Maine has mostly brick and concrete wall types.

data.content:
Yes. It's a known, open issue: [NatLabRockies/resstock#1309](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/resstock/issues/1309), opened October 2024. It is titled "Mobile homes with Structural Brick and CMU Wall Types".

- **Cause:** The `Geometry Wall Type` characteristic is built from Lightbox assessor data. A maintainer said that data may be unreliable. The brick or CMU values may actually be foundation or skirting on manufactured homes.
- **Maine:** In a follow-up comment, the same maintainer said Lightbox shows Maine as mostly brick and concrete walls. They called for a broader look at the data.
- **Status:** The issue is still open, with no assignee, fix or linked pull request. I found no other Maine-specific issue, and my issue searches were limited.

**What to do for Maine wall type results:**
- Don't rely on the brick or CMU wall-type results for Maine without checking them. This applies most to mobile homes.
- Check the `Geometry Wall Type` distribution for Maine against independent sources such as RECS or local housing surveys.
- Consider overriding the Maine `Geometry Wall Type` distribution (and its dependencies) with your own tested data and re-sampling. Alternatively, report wall-dependent results for Maine with a caveat.
- Comment on issue #1309 with your use case, and ask the ResStock team about the current status or any fix in the latest release.
